title: Sub-folder playlists from the card
summary: The sub-folders of the card's folder odrig are playlists of their own, the root playlist plays its own items and then each folder once, an operator picks a folder from the app as the playlist that plays now, and a playlist repeats for 24 hours of running time before the next one starts; in the core, the firmware's and the emulator's listing, and the app.
